instruction.text: Choose the correct reason why a certain need is important for plants.

b.sound: Soil provides plants with minerals and nutrients and gives roots a structure to hold on to.
Soil protects a plant from being eaten by predators.
Water helps a plant make food for itself and to transport nutrients.
Water helps keep plants cool in the heat.

feedback.finish: Plants absorb water, nutrients and minerals through the roots. The amount of water necessary depends on the type of plant and how much water it receives in its environment. All living things need water to survive.

b.sound: Sunlight is necessary for a plant to make food for itself.
Plants use sunlight to get rid of any extra water they have.

feedback.finish: Using the green colouring in its leaves, called chlorophyll, a plant absorbs energy from the sun. Together with water and air, this energy is converted into the sugar and oxygen that a plant needs. This process is called photosynthesis.

b.sound: Sunlight provides the warmth that all living things on Earth need to survive.
Plants need sunlight in order to tell the time.
Air keeps plants fresh and relaxed.

feedback.finish: Plants breathe just like animals do! They have tiny holes under their leaves called stomata that they use to breathe. Plants need the oxygen and carbon dioxide in the air in order to photosynthesise.

instruction.text: Give this seed everything it needs to help it grow! Drag the different needs to the correct boxes.

atoms.text: Great! By giving this seed the soil, water, light, warmth and air that it needed, it grew into a healthy sunflower plant!
